data_restrictions: MIT License, per the dataset repository.
reference_mapping_status: Clusters.txt lists the reads of each Centers.txt strand in the same order, so CNR supplies the read-to-reference association. benchmarks/convert_cnr_to_physical.py --supplied-output scores a subset with that association. run_physical_dataset.py instead reassigns every read to its nearest reference by edit distance; that path exercises the generic adapter and is not the authoritative CNR reconstruction result.
notes: Provenance only; the data is not bundled. CNR strands were not encoded with OligoArk, so results are reference-reconstruction accuracy, not an end-to-end decoding claim. See docs/external-cnr-benchmark.md for the authoritative held-out BBS comparison.
known_limitations: Upstream README, note added on 8/12/2024: the 10,000 source sequences were meant to be uniformly random but contain long-range dependencies due to an error in their generation. The clustering algorithm may therefore behave unexpectedly and some recovered clusters may be malformed, which makes trace reconstruction harder.
